integrity.computation_role: The bundled script is a finite replay of algebraic identities on sample parameters; it is not used as an infinite proof.
integrity.novelty_scope: Originality assessment is limited to the inspected primary source, targeted published-finding searches, and directly relevant squared-residual literature.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact diagonalization of the two signed proximal maps, an analytic geometric-mean condition-number bound, and the classical exact minimax fixed-step formula for a positive-definite quadratic.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the balanced four-mode symmetric indefinite quadratic and fixed scalar gradient descent on the exact paired merit.
It does not lower-bound accelerated, variable-step, preconditioned, Krylov, or other methods for the stationary-point problem.
It does not analyze asymmetric endpoint classes or inexact inner proximal-solve cost.
An equivalent calculation could exist in older proximal-average or rational-filter literature under different terminology.
title: Paired Moreau merit has an unavoidable squared-conditioning barrier on balanced indefinite quadratics
